Factory encounter

Run: 50% less AP, double speed. Sneak: 50% more AP, half speed, +20 stealth. Applies to selected mercs.

All levels stay visible. Select a level to move or interact on it.

Click an opponent to plan a shot.

Prototype coverage

Movement, combat, guard turns and reload use the current sprite game rules. Characters walk between tiles and settle into their equipment carry poses. Rifles now raise, fire with recoil and show their shot path. Select Anya to try it. Stance controls use the sprite rules. Shift-drag selects a group; Shift-click toggles a merc. Ground clicks move the group; Stance buttons affect all selected mercs; Fire and Reload use the primary merc. Other weapon animations, climbing, inventory and campaign UI are next.

Easy reveals exteriors. Room interiors stay black until a merc sees them through a door or window, or enters the room. Explored scenery is remembered; unseen corners remain black. Opponents require accumulated visual awareness in line of sight. Light, exposure, movement and skills affect recognition. ? marks an approximate glimpse or a remembered position, not a target. Unseen loot is not revealed.
